title: IngestRequest
description: Request to ingest a document into the RAG pipeline.

metadata.description: Caller-supplied document metadata. NOT READ BY ANY HANDLER TODAY (#575): it is accepted and discarded, and nothing in the chunk payload, Qdrant or Elasticsearch reflects it. Wiring it up requires typing the known fields here FIRST — contracts/schemas/chunk_metadata.json declares them (names, types, and which are optional-and-meaningful-when-absent) and the ingest boundary enforces that declaration — because a free object lets a caller send {"year": "2025"}, which Elasticsearch would coerce to a long while Qdrant stored a string, leaving a document the filter grammar (which declares year an integer field and never coerces, #471) can address on neither leg.

collection.description: Target collection id (from GET /v1/collections). Omitted → the server default collection. Documents are indexed with the target collection's bound embedder/chunker; an unknown id returns 404.
